facts.fact: CIVICUS Monitor says the Mauritian Information and Communications Authority directed internet service providers on 1 November 2024 to suspend access to Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and X, and that the ban was lifted on 2 November 2024 after 24 hours.
facts.system: Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and X suspension

facts.fact: CIVICUS Monitor says civil society groups and businesses opposed the social media suspension and that members of the party Linion Reform protested in front of the National Assembly on 1 November 2024.
facts.system: Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and X suspension

MUS.note: The document states no consultation on a digital law or policy.
